prepared_checkout_difference: none; the prepared checkout was exactly the recorded base commit
summary: The candidate is a substantive partial fix: it repairs Qwen3.5 causal and conditional class support for the repository's nested KV calibration schema and passes independent hybrid-layer, TP-rank, validation, four-representation, and Triton-consumer checks. It does not load the exact flat calibration JSON published in the original issue, so it does not fully satisfy the original contract.

tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, all four actual Qwen3.5 entry classes lacked load_kv_cache_scales and load_model_utils.load_kv_cache_scales raised the reported RuntimeError for Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration. Raw output: reports/j-9cb0fe6a54a8/base-reproduction.log.
At exact candidate commit, 10 tests and 6 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-9cb0fe6a54a8/candidate-tests.log.

Dense/MoE causal classes, both conditional wrappers through the real loader utility, TP-rank-dependent values, hybrid non-contiguous attention layers, all four scale fields, Triton descale selection, invalid calibration rejection, and the exact issue fixture counterexample. Raw output: reports/j-9cb0fe6a54a8/independent-adversarial.log.
MI355X gfx950 FP8 E4M3 quantize/dequantize at scale 0.5 exactly matched an independent CPU reference. Raw output: reports/j-9cb0fe6a54a8/amd-fp8-check.log.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015 executed the independent FP8 arithmetic check; see amd-fp8-check.log. No Qwen3.5 weights or distributed serving run were available.
remaining_counterexamples: The exact flat JSON shown in the original issue has top-level scaling_factor rather than kv_cache.scaling_factor. QuantParamSchema rejects it; the loader catches the error and leaves k_scale, v_scale, k_scale_float, and v_scale_float unset, effectively using scale 1.0.

The candidate's failing-before artifact is a collection-time helper ImportError, not the original loader RuntimeError, although this review independently reproduced the real RuntimeError on the recorded base.
remaining_limitations: The exact Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B weights and eight NVIDIA L20 GPUs with TP=8 were unavailable, so exact startup, distributed execution, and semantic generation remain unverified.
Available GPU validation was limited to one AMD Instinct MI355X and independent FP8 arithmetic; it did not execute a full Qwen3.5 attention backend with model weights.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json records no native build target, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
origin/main advanced after image preparation; all failing-before comparisons nevertheless used the mandated recorded base commit.
